limitations: Physical acceptance does not establish throughput or energy.
991/1000 exact authored jokes on a predominantly synthetic evaluation.
Physical acceptance covers seven frozen validation cases and three frozen completions.
Fresh-load speed evidence covers three prompts with ten timed requests each.
Resident speed evidence covers the same three prompts in one boot and includes score capture and checking in the back-to-back rates. Longer-duration throughput and energy remain unmeasured.

benchmark_freeze.format: W16A16, selected channel-balanced conversion with original hardware scales
benchmark_freeze.policy: Preserve these weights, geometry, input encoding, decoding and numerical rules. Retraining, changed weights or precision require a separately identified variant. Hardware implementations and measurement protocols may change under new identities while retaining this model and the relevant comparison controls.
